cases.note: Cells past a row's written width are the defaults.
With fill-empty off (its default), a written empty cell stays empty.
With fill-empty on, a written empty cell takes its default.
A cell of spaces strips to empty and then takes its default.
Each row keeps the defaults in force where it was written.

cases.note: A missing key reads as the defaults at the end of replay; get prints that row and exits 3.
With #_return_defaults_when_missing_# false, get prints nothing for a missing key and exits 3.
A lone #_return_defaults_when_missing_# resets it to true.
get strips a requested key's trailing space while stripping is in force, as a reader resolves keys.
